issue_context.title: Logitech Media Player / Squeezebox - Unable to select digital input on Logitech Transporter
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Using `media_player.play_media` service with `"source:toslink"` on a Logitech Transporter throws an error (`URL is relative, but does not start with a /`)

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.4.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.3.8

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Logitech Squeezebox

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/squeezebox

### Diagnostics information

        entity_id: media_player.transporter
        media_content_id: "source:toslink"
        media_content_type: "music"

comments:
Hey there @rajlaud, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`squeezebox`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L964) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
I was able to reproduce this and have submitted a PR to fix it. ~In the meantime, you can avoid this bug by using `channel` as your `media_content_type` instead of `music`.~

Just a note:
Changing `media_content_type` from `music` to `channel` does not work (both before and after the fix). At least not on the Logitech Transporter.
Sorry about that @jladefoged. Thanks for the report.

review_comments: Ah my bad. I didn't realize that `async_load_url` would also be used with non-urls
